primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: WEB固定版の使徒6:9で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.
WEB固定版の使徒15:23で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: They wrote these things by their hand: “The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.
WEB固定版の使徒15:41で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.
WEB固定版の使徒21:39で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: But Paul said, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city. I beg you, allow me to speak to the people.”

WEB固定版の使徒22:3で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: “I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed according to the strict tradition of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as you all are today.
WEB固定版の使徒23:34で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: When the governor had read it, he asked what province he was from. When he understood that he was from Cilicia, he said,
WEB固定版の使徒27:5で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: When we had sailed across the sea which is off Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.
